findings.evidence: `Model.lean:13-16` "The construction is the standard-model prerequisite for putting a manifold structure on the boundary ... The parametrization and projection API below is intended to let boundary charts use this identification". Everything the block needs is already available in `Model.lean`: `modelWithCornersEuclideanHalfSpace_toFun`/`_symm_apply` at `Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/Instances/Real.lean:243,246`, `frontier_range_modelWithCornersEuclideanHalfSpace` already used at `Model.lean:213`, and `ModelWithCorners.boundary` via `Instances/Real.lean:9` `public import Mathlib.Geometry.Manifold.IsManifold.InteriorBoundary`.
findings.fix: Move the whole `section Model` into `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/Boundary/Model.lean`; no import changes are needed there.
findings.issue: `section Model` (lines 108–184: `euclideanHalfSpaceParam`, `euclideanHalfSpaceProj`, `euclideanHalfSpaceParam_coe`, `euclideanHalfSpaceProj_param`, `euclideanHalfSpaceParam_proj`, `continuous_euclideanHalfSpaceParam/Proj`, `modelWithCornersEuclideanHalfSpace_param`, `modelWithCornersEuclideanHalfSpace_symm_param`, `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryParam_mem_range`, `boundary_euclideanHalfSpace`) is entirely model-level: it mentions no manifold `M`, no chart, and nothing from this file. Its canonical home is `Boundary/Model.lean`, whose docstring says it exists to supply exactly this parametrization/projection API to boundary charts. Consumers of the model identification currently must import the whole charts file (dragging in `Mathlib.Geometry.Manifold.SmoothEmbedding`/`Immersion`) to get it.

findings.evidence: Lines 85–88 quantify over `{𝕜} {E} {H} {I : ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H} {M}`; the proofs use only `ModelWithCorners.isInteriorPoint_iff_of_mem_atlas` (`Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/IsManifold/InteriorBoundary.lean:305`) and `OpenPartialHomeomorph.interior_extend_target_subset_interior_range`/`mem_interior_extend_target` (`Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/IsManifold/ExtChartAt.lean:169,176`). `grep -rl "IsInteriorPoint\|IsBoundaryPoint" TauCeti/` shows no existing generic interior/boundary file, so a new one is required rather than an existing home.
findings.fix: Split it into a new low-level file (e.g. `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/Boundary/Basic.lean`) importing only `Mathlib.Geometry.Manifold.IsManifold.InteriorBoundary`, and import that from `Charts.lean`.
findings.issue: `section ChartIndependence` (`isInteriorPoint_iff_mem_interior_range`, `isBoundaryPoint_iff_mem_frontier_range`, lines 90–104) is stated for an arbitrary `ModelWithCorners 𝕜 E H` and has nothing to do with the Euclidean half-space or with boundary charts. Placed in a file whose topic is the half-space boundary charted space, this broadly useful pair is unfindable and cannot be imported without the SmoothEmbedding/Immersion dependency.

summary: The new file is in the right directory, but it bundles two lower-level layers that belong elsewhere: the half-space model API duplicates the stated topic of the sibling `Boundary/Model.lean`, and the model-independent chart-detection lemmas are generic material buried in a half-space-specific file. Imports are otherwise fine.
